# Pinned development toolchain for CI.
#
# Why this file exists: CI was installing `ruff pytest mypy` unpinned, so every
# run resolved whatever was newest. That means the rules the gate enforces could
# change without anyone committing anything — a red build with no diff to
# explain it, and a green build that proves less than it appears to. In a repo
# whose STACK.md §2 calls every dependency a supply-chain surface, an unpinned
# install in the one process that vouches for the code is the wrong default.
#
# Local development installs the same set, so "passes locally" and "passes in
# CI" compare like with like:
#
#     python3 -m venv .venv
#     .venv/bin/pip install -r .github/requirements/dev.txt
#
# Bumping: change a version here deliberately, run the full gate, commit the
# change on its own. Dependabot opens the PR (.github/dependabot.yml).
#
# NOT hash-locked yet. `--require-hashes` is the next step and needs
# `uv pip compile --generate-hashes` (or pip-compile) run once uv is available
# on the machine that regenerates this. Version pinning already removes the
# silent-drift problem; hashes additionally remove the tampered-artifact one.
# Do not describe this file as hash-locked until it is.

# Direct
mypy==2.3.1
pytest==9.1.1
ruff==0.16.7

# Transitive, pinned so the resolution is reproducible rather than merely
# constrained. Generated from a working environment with `pip freeze`.
ast_serialize==0.11.1
iniconfig==2.3.0
librt==0.15.0
mypy_extensions==1.1.0
packaging==26.3
pathspec==1.1.1
pluggy==1.6.0
Pygments==2.21.0
typing_extensions==4.16.0
